replace.faq.dataOnly: Do you have plans with a phone number?
replace.faq.answerDataOnly: Yes. Most plans are data only: no phone number, no regular calls and no SMS, and calls and messages keep working on your own line or over WhatsApp. We also sell plans with a phone number: a US number, a French number that works across Europe, and a global number. You will find them under the "With a phone number" tab on the destination page.
replace.legalPages.refundContent:
This Refund Policy applies to all customers in all countries.

The eSIM is delivered immediately after payment. There are therefore no refunds after purchase, even if the eSIM has not been installed. This applies to every plan: data by the GB, unlimited, and plans with a phone number.

If your eSIM was not delivered because of a fault on our side, contact support with your order number and we will sort it out.

faq.phoneWhatIs: What is an eSIM with a phone number?
faq.answerPhoneWhatIs: One eSIM that gives you data, a phone number, call minutes and SMS. You can receive calls and verification codes on it, from your bank or from apps, for example. Your own number stays on your phone as a second line.
faq.phoneWhenNumber: When do I get my phone number?
faq.answerPhoneWhenNumber: The number is assigned once you install the eSIM on your phone. We email you as soon as it is ready, and it also shows in your account. The plan's validity starts when you install it, so install close to your trip.
faq.unlimitedHowWorks: How does an unlimited plan work?
faq.answerUnlimitedHowWorks: Pick how many days your trip lasts, from 1 to 30. Each day you get 2GB at full speed, then unlimited data at a reduced speed until the end of the day. Full speed comes back the next day.
